description: Aggregator / harvest roadmap resume manifest. Repo-tracked so the NAS always-on heartbeat (loop.py) reads the current queue after each sovereign-mirror fetch. Items are in dependency order. The 'driver' field tells the NAS what capacity category is currently needed to advance the item: 'none'=done, 'deterministic'=NAS can run this without LLM, 'llm'=needs LLM reasoning or coding, 'human'=needs a human decision or credential. When the vendor LLM is offline, the heartbeat logs deterministic-pending items so they can be queued for NAS pipeline-runner execution; llm-pending items are held and surfaced for the next LLM session. Declared: Darrell 2026-07-02 (institutional-memory / resume-manifest principle).

items.title: Sovereign aggregator backbone + source-adapter seam (pluggable, multi-tenant, platform-agnostic)
items.notes: Migration 0066 live; CI guard passing (source-adapter-guard.mjs); 2 adapters (YouTube + RSS), 2 platforms declared. No COLG hardcode.

items.title: YouTube caption / transcript pipeline (load-transcripts.py, NAS-resident)
items.notes: Script: infra/nas-sme-pipeline/load-transcripts.py. Fetches auto-captions via youtube_transcript_api; writes video_harvests + video_transcripts (source=youtube-asr). NAS-runnable without LLM. Lane local_4d62ae64. Run: python3 load-transcripts.py on NAS.

items.title: YouTube choir songs extraction (transcript to structured song records: title / key / theme)
items.notes: LLM extracts structured song records (title, key, theme tags) from raw transcript text. Output feeds the Choir Songbook module.

items.title: YouTube sermon points + scripture extraction (transcript to numbered outline + scripture refs)
items.notes: LLM extracts numbered points + Scripture references from transcript. Output feeds the Pulpit / study surface.

items.title: YouTube order of service extraction (transcript to structured OOS segments)
items.notes: LLM identifies and structures OOS segments from transcript. Output feeds the Order of Service module.

items.title: YouTube historical events extraction (transcript to dated event records)
items.notes: LLM pulls named events, dates, and context from transcripts. Output feeds the Historical Events module.

items.title: Fix: shared channel-latest feed (Church + Choir + The Word + Video Wall all auto-show latest upload)
items.notes: Decouple show-video from mine-content. All four surfaces must display the latest channel upload independently of whether the harvest pipeline has run. Fake-green banner is also blocked on this. Code change needed in display layer.

items.title: Fix: fake-green harvest banner (display real run status from content_sources, not painted green)
items.notes: Harvest banner must reflect actual last_run_at + last_run_status from the NAS pipeline record in content_sources, not a hardcoded or inferred green.

items.title: RSS / podcast feed ingest (rss-ingest.py, proves seam genericity)
items.notes: Script: infra/nas-sme-pipeline/rss-ingest.py. Stdlib-only, normalizes RSS/Atom to CanonicalItem, writes source_platform=rss rows. NAS-runnable without LLM. Lane local_baedd723. Run: python3 rss-ingest.py <feed_url> on NAS.

items.title: RSS display layer (buildLedger coverage % includes RSS items, not just YouTube / choir_sermons)
items.notes: Current gap: buildLedger() in harvest-ledger.js joins choir_sermons (YouTube-only corpus). RSS items are in video_harvests (source_platform=rss) but invisible in coverage %. Fix the display query to be platform-agnostic.

items.title: Adapter: Facebook + LinkedIn (Darrell own accounts, API-OAuth path first)
items.notes: OAuth credential setup is a human step (Darrell holds the credential). Once credentials are in place, adapter code is llm-driven. Capture metadata as first-class. Sovereign: data-IN-liberal / data-OUT-protected.

items.title: Adapter: IG / TikTok / X (after Facebook + LinkedIn proven)
items.notes: Same pattern as social-fb-linkedin: own accounts first, API-OAuth or Download-Your-Data path. Depends on fb/linkedin proving the seam pattern works for personal accounts.

items.title: Download-Your-Data export-archive ingest path (all platforms, maximal owner-consented completeness)
items.notes: After at least one social adapter is coded. Export archives are deterministic ingest once the adapter parses the format. Sovereign, no-leak, owner-consented. Personal life-corpus + timeline target.

items.title: Historical events: in-app create primitive (title / date / category / notes, baseline entry point)
items.notes: First-class in-app event creation before harvest seeds it. Baseline ensures Darrell can enter events manually even without a completed harvest adapter. Code change: new surface + migration.

items.title: Historical events: seed from past-video + platform harvest (connect extraction output to events primitive)
items.notes: NAS deterministically pipes LLM-extracted event records into the in-app primitive once both exist. Script to be written after historical-events-primitive lands.
